### Falcon’s Beyond Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


November 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/341371958/files/doc_news/Falcons-Beyond-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf)


*Company Reports Consolidated Revenue of **$7.3 Million** for Q3 , an 80% increase over prior year.*


*Company's Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Falcon's Creative Group, generated Q3 revenue of **$5.2 Million***


*Company's Unconsolidated Joint Venture, Producciones de Parques, generated Q3 revenue of **$11.8 Million***


ORLANDO, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Falcon’s Beyond Global, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ffalconsbeyond.com%2F&esheet=54639931&newsitemid=20261112120171&lan=en-US&anchor=Falcon%26%238217%3Bs+Beyond+Global%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=25eb177bd591cfec79c208748665556a) (Nasdaq: FBYD) (“Falcon’s Beyond”, “Falcon’s” or the “Company”), a visionary entertainment and technology enterprise through its three complementary business divisions Falcon’s Creative (“FC”), Falcon’s Beyond Brands (“FBB”), and Falcon’s Beyond Destinations (“FBD”) reported financial results for the third quarter 2026.


**Third Quarter 2026 Highlights**


**Revenue**


Falcon's generated consolidated revenue of $7.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, an 80% increase over the prior period. Revenue for the quarter consisted of attraction services and product sales, creative services, management fees earned from Producciones de Parques, S.L. (“PDP”), the Company's 50:50 joint venture with Meliá Hotels International, and corporate and shared services fees earned from Falcon's Creative Group. Falcon's Attractions and Falcon's Beyond Creative, ended the quarter with contracted pipelines totaling $28.0 million.


**Equity Method Investments**


*Falcon's Creative Group (“FCG”)*


- FCG recorded revenue of $5.2 million for the three month period ended September 30, 2026, representing a $0.5 million decrease over the same period of the prior year. FCG recorded operating loss of $4.0 million and net loss was $4.2 million. After the Qiddiya Investment Company's (“QIC”) preferred return and amortization of basis difference, Falcon’s share of net loss from FCG was $5.9 million. FCG had a contracted pipeline of $13.0 million as it closed out Q3 2026.


*Producciones de Parques (“PDP”)*


- PDP recognized $11.8 million in revenues for the three month period ended September 30, 2026, representing a $0.6 million increase over same period of the prior year. Operating income was $3.7 million and net income was $3.5 million. Falcon's share of net gain from PDP was $1.7 million.


**Net Loss**


Falcon's recorded a consolidated net loss of $7.7 million for the three month period ended September 30, 2026, a $2.7 million improvement over the prior year, due to careful oversight of operating expenses as the business continues to scale.


**Adjusted EBITDA**


Falcon's generated Adjusted EBITDA(1) loss of $7.4 million in the three month period ended September 30, 2026, a $0.3 million improvement over the prior year.


___________


(1) Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP financial measure. See “Use and Definition of Non-GAAP Financial Measure” below for more information and a reconciliation to the most directly comparable GAAP measure.


**Other Business Highlights**


“Our third-quarter results demonstrate continued progress in our growth strategy as we move from building pipeline to executing and delivering major projects. The VAI project announced earlier this year is now underway, bringing together the integrated capabilities of Falcon's Creative and Falcon's Attractions to work across creative design, engineering and attraction delivery.” said Cecil D. Magpuri, Chief Executive Officer of Falcon’s Beyond. "As we build on this momentum, we remain intensely focused on disciplined execution as we scale the business and capitalize on the significant opportunities ahead."


**About Falcon’s Beyond**


**Falcon’s Beyond** is a visionary entertainment and technology enterprise at the forefront of the global experience economy. We design, develop, engineer, deliver, and commercialize immersive physical and digital experiences for leading brands, developers, and destination operators worldwide, as well as for our own portfolio of entertainment and technology concepts. Our business is built on an integrated experience platform that brings together creative development, proprietary technologies, advanced engineering, intellectual property, and operational execution to enable the repeatable creation, deployment, and scaling of entertainment experiences across multiple formats and locations globally. We operate through three complementary business divisions:


- **Falcon’s Creative** , consisting of Falcon’s Creative Group and Falcon’s Beyond Creative, provides creative and advisory services including destination strategy, master planning, experiential and attraction design, digital media, interactive software, intellectual property development, and creative guardianship for entertainment and hospitality destinations.
- **Falcon’s Beyond Brands** , consisting of Falcon’s Attractions and Falcon’s Beyond Brands, encompasses a broad portfolio of intellectual property, proprietary technologies, and operating businesses that design, engineer, commercialize, and deploy entertainment systems, products, content, and experiences across physical and digital environments.
- **Falcon’s Beyond Destinations** , consisting of Producciones de Parques, S.L., a joint venture between Falcon’s and Meliá Hotels International, S.A., and Destinations Operations, develops, owns, operates, and expands entertainment venues, hospitality experiences, and branded destination concepts across a variety of location‑based formats, utilizing proprietary and third‑party intellectual property.


FALCON’S BEYOND and its related trademarks are owned by Falcon’s Beyond.


Falcon’s is headquartered in Orlando, FL. Learn more at[falconsbeyond.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ffalconsbeyond.com%2F&esheet=54639931&newsitemid=20261112120171&lan=en-US&anchor=falconsbeyond.com.&index=2&md5=bee5b1a31b843bec592e9cf047a1bbfb)

**Use and Definition of Non-GAAP Financial Measure**


We prepare our consolidated financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP. In addition to financial measures prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP, we present Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP financial measure. We define Adjusted EBITDA as net income (loss) before interest expense, interest income, income taxes, depreciation and amortization, transaction-related credits, changes in the fair value of warrant liabilities, impairment charges, and certain gains or losses associated with equity method investments that are not considered indicative of our core operating performance.


Management believes Adjusted EBITDA provides useful supplemental information regarding the operating performance of our business by excluding the effects of financing decisions, capital structure, depreciation and amortization, and other items that may not be representative of ongoing operations. Adjusted EBITDA should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for net income (loss), operating income (loss), cash flows from operating activities, or other measures prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP. A reconciliation of net income (loss), the most directly comparable U.S. GAAP measure, to Adjusted EBITDA is included below.
